body.text: We have locked some of the files in your shared folder.
Send a ransom payment within 24 hours, or we will leak the files.

explanation: This is a ransomware threat that affects data across the whole office. Don't reply or pay: escalate to the senior analyst and the managers so the incident response can start.
hints: This is not about one email anymore. How big is the impact?
Decisions about a ransom and the whole office's data are not one analyst's call.
